purpose: Icon-only product badge renderer for product cards and PDP media surfaces.
businessRules: Badges must render as compact icons with hover text so product imagery is not covered by long badge labels.

Badge icons must be semantic and distinct: bestseller uses Flame, certification uses BadgeCheck, anti-tarnish uses ShieldCheck, water resistance uses Droplets, wedding uses Crown, silk/saree uses Shirt, new uses Sparkles, and unknown badges use Star.
Display labels come from enumDisplayLabel while the backend enum value remains unchanged.
Hover labels must stay inside the overflow-clipped product media frame and must never hang below the image/card boundary.
All badge hover labels expand inward from the top-left badge row, wrap within a bounded pill, and allow at most two short lines so long backend tags remain readable without escaping the image box.
Do not reintroduce per-icon right-aligned hover labels on product media; badges near the left edge can clip when labels expand left.
